reviewer.product: SuperGrok consumer interface via human bridge + GitHub connector

criteria.note: Relevant Google surfaces are classified (Gemini API, AI Studio, Vertex, ADK/A2A, Live, NotebookLM, Colab, Firebase/Firestore, Apps Script, Labs/media). Explicitly framed as evidence for routing, not required architecture. Unnecessary/unverified products kept out of ACTIVE.

Material claims that are made point to official Google docs (rate limits, terms, pricing, Vertex quotas, Firebase free tier numbers, Apps Script quota table). Account-specific status is correctly marked UNKNOWN and listed under missing-evidence gates rather than asserted. Live project/billing snapshots were not taken (forbidden/not available) and are explicitly blocked.

Strict-zero eligibility and subscription vs API separation are explicit: Vertex blocked under STRICT_ZERO_CARD; AI Studio HUMAN_BRIDGE only; free-tier Firebase numbers stated without claiming all Firebase free; no paid path activated.

ACTIVE is not overused. PREVIEW/UNKNOWN/HUMAN_BRIDGE/BLOCKED are visibly separated for Live, Labs/media, NotebookLM, Colab, Firebase, Apps Script, Vertex. Product names alone are not treated as proof of rollout or rights.

ResponsePacket is separate from UJ-CAP-001, schema required fields present, status=REVIEW, proposed_accepted_weight=0, artifacts list only the external evidence pack with matching SHA-256 (no circular self-hash). source_commit_sha is a real 40-hex commit (3611b1b…) that is fetchable; see finding F-001 for card-repin note.
